segmentation_config.totalsegmentator_requirement: >=2.0 (Apache-2.0, inference only; weights fetched on first use)
segmentation_config.totalsegmentator_version: recorded per series once inference has run
segmentation_config.torch_version: recorded per series once inference has run
segmentation_config.alignment_with_iorn006: Same TotalSegmentator 'total' task and the same abdominal roi_subset as IORN-006 (ctsegdose-core). IORN-006 defaults to the 3 mm fast model and offers 1.5 mm via --full-resolution; IORN-007 defaults to full 1.5 mm because absorbed organ dose is sensitive to partial-volume error at organ boundaries. This is an intentional difference, recorded here rather than left implicit. TotalSegmentator and torch versions are pinned only as >=2.0 in pyproject and captured exactly, per series, in each series' JSON.
